name: OmniAgent
postCreateCommand: pip install --upgrade pip && pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env)
postStartCommand: python -c "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer as S; S('sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2')" || true

QDRANT_URL.description: Qdrant Cloud cluster URL (leave unset for in-memory Qdrant)

ELASTICSEARCH_URL.description: Elasticsearch endpoint (leave unset for in-process BM25)

REDIS_URL.description: Managed Redis URL, e.g. rediss://... (leave unset for in-memory cache)
